# tomorrow.md — Next-Day Override

> **Template note.** This file is the leader's intent for the next working day. It exists so the morning brief starts from the leader's actual priorities, not from whatever happens to be in the inbox and on the calendar. It is the cleanest signal the AI Chief of Staff has.
>
> The AI Chief of Staff drafts this file at end of day (via the `end-of-day-close` behaviour). The leader reviews and approves before it is saved. The morning brief reads it first.
>
> Keep this under 150 words. If it gets longer, it stops being read.
